• Let's look at the sentence: "Over the past year, Dr. Hemmings has been conducting research on the big cat phenomenon and has already** ______** the remains of some wild animals..."
 
• We can say that the implied meaning of the sentence is Dr. Hemmings has been researching the big cat phenomenon, and he has already recognized the remains of some wild animals.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "identified" to make the sentence meaningfully correct.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
